comparison.objective: Candidate depins a connector; record routes two cables into a carrier and closes every crossbar.
comparison.physical_skill: Wire deflection, recessed tool insertion, and coupled withdrawal versus extended cable routing, ordering, and repeated snap-latching.
comparison.success_condition: One terminal removed intact and alone versus both cables continuously seated on assigned sides without crossing and every crossbar latched.
comparison.reason: Both involve cables and latches, but one releases a terminal while the other routes cables and creates multiple latches.
